Expense Reimbursement Policy (Test Fixture)

This is sample test-fixture content for the AI Orchestrator's Phase 2
Search pipeline. It is not real EZOFIS documentation.

Employees may submit expense reports for reimbursement of approved
business expenses, including travel, meals, and client entertainment. All
expense claims must include an itemized receipt and be submitted within 30
days of the expense date. Reimbursement requires manager approval before
payment is issued.

Expenses submitted without a receipt over $25 will not be reimbursed
except in exceptional, pre-approved circumstances.
